source_context.caption_hook: I built a Claude skill that creates LinkedIn carousels in minutes.
caption_argument_segments: I built a Claude skill that creates LinkedIn carousels in minutes.
Carousels are one of the highest-performing formats on LinkedIn. They also take the longest to produce. This skill builds them in minutes.
Drop in an infographic, and it rebuilds it as a carousel. Or feed it a topic and it creates one from scratch.
It asks you a few questions first - brand colours, slide count, audience, layout. Everything comes out matched to you.
Here is how to set it up:
1. Go to claude.ai 2. Click on the + icon in the chat bar 3. Select Skills 4. Create Skill 5. Paste in the skill name, description, and instructions 6. Save
